missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: The project description details the workflow for submitting, managing, and updating AUU applications. The current High-Level Goals (HLGs) comprehensively cover all distinct functional intentions: 'Submit Assegno Unico Universale Application' covers the initial submission and validation; 'Manage Application Drafts' covers saving/resuming; 'Manage AUU Allowance Payment Setup' covers payment details; 'Modify Existing Application' covers adding children and updating data; 'Access Benefit Information' covers consulting info and simulating amounts; 'Receive Application Receipt' covers the confirmation document; 'Be Informed of Application Outcome' covers notifications; 'Consult Past Applications and History' covers reviewing previous submissions; 'Complete Shared Application' covers the co-parent workflow; and 'Process and Decide on AUU Applications' covers the INPS staff evaluation. The specific step of uploading documents when an application is suspended is a sub-step of the 'Modify Existing Application' or 'Be Informed of Application Outcome' workflow (specifically, responding to a suspension), and does not constitute a distinct high-level goal separate from managing the application's lifecycle. No other distinct actor-level functional intentions are present in the text that are not already covered by the existing HLGs.
